name: Giant Octopus
publication: DDEX1-11 - Dark Pyramid of Sorcerer's Isle
otherStatistics: Perception +4, Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. Languages —.
appearance: A green octopus with a rounded mantle and eight curling arms lined with pale suckers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDEX1-11, Dark Pyramid of Sorcerer's Isle, Appendix 1: Monster/NPC Statistics, p. 36.
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. Out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.
Underwater Camouflage. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made underwater.
Water Breathing. It can breathe only underwater.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit is grappled (escape DC 16) and remains restrained while grappled. The octopus cannot use Tentacles on another target until the grapple ends.
Ink Cloud (recharges after a short or long rest). While underwater, release a 20-ft.-radius cloud centered on the octopus. The cloud heavily obscures its area for 1 minute, and a strong current can disperse it. After releasing the ink, the octopus can take the Dash action as a bonus action.
sections.Encounter variant: Two giant octopuses try to pull people from a boat into the river. Two swarms of quippers attack anyone pulled into the water and leave the octopuses alone. The waist-deep river is difficult terrain and does not hinder attacks. The boat has AC 15 and 50 HP. A very weak party faces one octopus and one swarm. A weak party faces two octopuses and one swarm. A strong party faces two octopuses and three swarms. A very strong party faces three of each.

name: Crocodile
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Stealth +2. Passive Perception 10. Languages —.
appearance: An olive-brown crocodile with a long tooth-lined snout, scutes and a powerful tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDEX1-07, Drums in the Marsh, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, p. 21.
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage and grapples the target (escape DC 12). The target is restrained while grappled, and the crocodile cannot Bite another target until the grapple ends.

name: Boar
appearance: A dark brown boar with coarse bristles and short curved tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDEX3-02, Shackles of Blood, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, p. 28.
sections.Traits:
Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Tusk on the same turn to deal another 3 (1d6) slashing damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 11 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
Relentless (recharges after a short or long rest). If damage of 7 or less would reduce the boar to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions: Tusk. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Encounter variant: At the Red Plumes’ camp, a successful DC 15 Dexterity check using thieves’ tools unlocks the cage. If released, the boar attacks a random target and runs into the woods. If combat starts while it is still caged, it breaks free at the end of round two. It attacks the nearest creature with a +5 melee attack that deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage on a hit, then flees into the forest.

name: Giant Boar
appearance: A large bristly boar with a tall dark mane and heavy ivory tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDEX3-07, Herald of the Moon, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, p. 28.
sections.Traits:
Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Tusk on the same turn to deal another 7 (2d6) slashing damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 13 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
Relentless (recharges after a short or long rest). If damage of 10 or less would reduce the boar to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions: Tusk. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Encounter variant: One giant boar and two hill giants emerge from the Cormanthor forest shortly after the party arrives. Neither side is surprised. A very weak party faces only the two giants. A weak party faces one giant and three giant boars. A strong party faces two giants and three giant boars. A very strong party faces three giants and one giant boar.

name: Mastiff
appearance: A fawn guard mastiff with folded ears, a dark muzzle and stitched brown leather barding.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDEX2-02, Embers of Elmwood, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, p. 22.
sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on hearing or smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 11 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
sections.Encounter variant: Two mastiffs accompany a thug in the manor’s Grand Room. Their leather barding raises their AC to 13.
